description.value: Original Cupcakes (also known as Cupcakes by Heather & Lori) is a retro-styled BC bakery chain co-founded in 2002 by Heather White and Lori Joyce, specializing in whimsical cupcakes, cakes, and other nostalgic baked goods made fresh daily from scratch using preservative-free, natural ingredients. The brand earned international recognition as the original cupcakes bakery and was featured on the W Network reality show 'The Cupcake Girls,' broadcast in 90 countries. Locations in Guildford and Metrotown shopping centres offer a sweet-treat stop, though both are situated on the second floor of indoor malls.
